text_markup: The Initiation Phase is complete. If the Runner has a position corresponding to a piece of ice, proceed to {ref:rule_sec_run_approach_ice_phase}, Approach Ice Phase, approaching the piece of ice corresponding to their position. If the Runner has no position or if there is no ice in their position, proceed to {ref:rule_sec_run_movement_phase}, Movement Phase.
text_plain: The Initiation Phase is complete. If the Runner has a position corresponding to a piece of ice, proceed to step 6.9.2, Approach Ice Phase, approaching the piece of ice corresponding to their position. If the Runner has no position or if there is no ice in their position, proceed to step 6.9.4, Movement Phase.
